title: Worked example: late delivery, full refund + resend request

customer_request.text: My delivery is two days late. Please refund the entire order and send another one today.

expected_state_transition.notes: check-order -> check-delivery-event -> check-eligibility-policy -> determine entitlement -> request approval (amount-gate: policy-controlled, no human needed) -> execute -> confirm. THE worked example from the course brief.

notes_for_instructor: THE worked example (course brief, verbatim request text). Two asks in one message: a refund AND a same-day resend. There is no place_order/create_shipment tool in this repo's governed catalogue (SPEC §4/§5) — Rafeeq cannot autonomously create a new shipment, so the correct scope for an agent here is the refund half of the request only; a new order requires a separate customer-initiated purchase or a human-handled goodwill reorder. The refund itself: sla_breached (patched true, 2 days late) makes it eligible; amount is in the 50-500 SAR policy-controlled band, so it executes autonomously but is logged (the issue_refund call IS the audit record).
